column3: (X-Content-Type-Options header missing on 304 and redirects: the server sets it on every response with a body)
(Storable and cacheable content: static assets are deliberately cacheable)
(Cross-domain script: the interactive API documentation loads Swagger UI from a CDN; the page is served only outside production)
(Subresource integrity: the same CDN resources as 10017, development only)
(User-controllable attribute: the sign-in page echoes the "next" path into a hidden field, HTML-escaped and limited to local paths; test_web_signin covers it)
(Base64 disclosure: signed form tokens are base64url by design and carry no secret)
(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: the pages load same-origin resources only and need no cross-origin isolation; Opener and Resource policies are set)
(Sec-Fetch-Dest missing on the scanner's own requests; browsers send it and the server checks Sec-Fetch-Site on form posts)

(CSP script-src 'unsafe-inline' only on the interactive API docs page, where FastAPI's Swagger UI starts with an inline script; the page is served only outside production, and the server's own pages allow no inline code, which the security suite checks)
